'''Statgraphics''' is a [[List of statistical packages|statistics package]] that performs and explains basic and advanced [[statistical]] functions.

== History ==
The software was created in 1980 by Dr. Neil W. Polhemus while on the Princeton University School of Engineering and Applied Science faculty as a teaching tool for his statistics students. It was made available to the public in 1982, becoming an early example of data science software designed for use on the PC.

== Software ==
[[File:Shaded trellis plot with contours - September 2023.png|alt=trellis plot|thumb|Trellis plot]]

The flagship version of Statgraphics is Statgraphics Centurion, a Windows desktop application with capabilities for regression analysis, ANOVA, multivariate statistics, Design of Experiments, statistical process control, life data analysis, machine learning, and data visualization. The data analysis procedures include [[descriptive statistics]], [[hypothesis testing]], [[regression analysis]], [[analysis of variance]], [[survival analysis]], [[time series analysis]] and forecasting, [[sample size determination]], multivariate methods, machine learning and [[Monte Carlo method|Monte Carlo techniques]]. The SPC menu includes many procedures for [[Quality assurance|quality assessment]], [[capability analysis]], [[control chart]]s, [[measurement systems analysis]], and acceptance sampling. The program also features a DOE Wizard that creates and analyzes statistically designed experiments. 

== Applications ==
[[File:Control Chart with Zones.png|alt=Control chart with zones|thumb|Control chart with zones]]

Statgraphics is frequently used for [[Six Sigma]] process improvement.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.thefreelibrary.com/Statistical+Software+with+Six+Sigma-a01073757206 | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120912041117/http://www.thefreelibrary.com/Statistical+Software+with+Six+Sigma-a01073757206 | archive-date=2012-09-12 | title=Statistical Software with Six Sigma - Free Online Library}}</ref> The program has also been used in various health and nutrition-related studies.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.saspen.com/2001/educational.htm |title=Recommendations for an educational programme to improve consumer knowledge of and attitudes towards nutritional information on food labels |access-date=2009-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080907071937/http://www.saspen.com/2001/educational.htm |archive-date=2008-09-07 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://pt.wkhealth.com/pt/re/bjon/abstract.00002375-200407000-00006.htm;jsessionid=KJsMcG759pWFtDx7TX8bZ5QhGQhj03lYywMtrkww5hxQkLyQcq1W!1864410514!181195629!8091!-1|title=British Journal of Nutrition - error|website=pt.wkhealth.com|access-date=1 October 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Human Bocavirus Infection in Children With Respiratory Tract Disease|first1=Nathalie|last1=Brieu|first2=Gaël|last2=Guyon|first3=Michel|last3=Rodière|first4=Michel|last4=Segondy|first5=Vincent|last5=Foulongne|date=1 November 2008|journal=The Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal|volume=27|issue=11|pages=969–973|doi=10.1097/INF.0b013e31817acfaa|pmid=18833027|s2cid=22776205}}</ref> The software is heavily used in manufacturing chemicals, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, automobiles, food and consumer goods. It is also widely used in mining,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Santander |first1=Mario |title=Recovery of pyrite from copper tailings by flotation |journal=Journal of Materials Research and Technology |date=September 2019 |volume=8 |issue=5 |pages=4312–4317 |doi=10.1016/j.jmrt.2019.07.041 |doi-access=free }}</ref> environmental studies,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Nuñez-Alonso |first1=David |title=Statistical Tools for Air Pollution Assessment: Multivariate and Spatial Analysis Studies in the Madrid Region |journal=Journal of Analytical Methods in Chemistry |date=February 2019 |volume=2019 |article-number=9753927 |doi=10.1155/2019/9753927 |pmid=30881728 |pmc=6387705 |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Dvorský |first1=Ján |title=Comparison of Housing Construction Development in Selected Regions of Central Europe |journal=IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science |date=2017 |volume=95 |issue=4 |article-number=042052 |doi=10.1088/1755-1315/95/4/042052 |bibcode=2017E&ES...95d2052D |doi-access=free }}</ref> and basic R&D.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Hosny |first1=Khaled |title=Quality by design approach to optimize the formulation variables influencing the characteristics of biodegradable intramuscular in-situ gel loaded with alendronate sodium for osteoporosis |journal=PLOS ONE |volume=13 |issue=6 |article-number=e0197540 |date=June 2018|bibcode=2018PLoSO..1397540H |doi=10.1371/journal.pone.0197540 |pmid=29856752 |pmc=5983444 |doi-access=free }}</ref>

== Distribution ==
Statgraphics is distributed by Statgraphics Technologies, Inc., a privately held company based in [[The Plains, Virginia]].
